Now, we could make a really bad pun out of this: "Too late."

But I'm not going to do that. Far below the dignity of an Aes Sedai. Anyway, I was surprised about the way it was revealed. I had suspected him to use it against Galad, to bring him into his fold, but in fact, it seems like Rand has all randomly forgotten about some things. Then again, the fact that the saviour of the world doesn't give a crap about you is quite the proof of your misguided and unworthy-of-noticeable existence.
